summary: The Sun is the main-sequence star at the center of the Solar System. It begins each loop as an aging yellow star, becomes a Red Giant after about 12 minutes, and explodes into a supernova at the 22-minute mark, ending the loop.

biology: The Sun is a large main-sequence star at the center of the Solar System.
All other astronomical bodies in the Solar System orbit the Sun.
The Sun's in-game database flags it as UNSTABLE with 'accelerated nuclear fusion detected in core.'
behavior: The Sun ages and grows in size over the course of every 22-minute loop.
Prior to the start of the loop the Sun was much more yellow, indicating it had already become a subgiant shortly before the loop began.
At the start of the loop and for most of its duration, the Sun is colored orange in its subgiant phase.
Roughly 12 minutes into the cycle, the Sun expands to roughly twice its normal size and becomes a Red Giant.
The Sun's Red Giant phase engulfs and destroys the Sun Station.
At about 21 minutes into the cycle, the 'End Times' theme begins, signaling 60 seconds until supernova.
At 22 minutes, the Sun collapses inward, briefly becomes a small sphere, then explodes in a blue flash.
The supernova blast grows and accelerates to encompass the entire Solar System.
location: The Sun lies at the center of the Solar System.
The Sun Station is the Sun's only noteworthy artificial feature, in a very close and quick heliocentric orbit.
lore: The Sun Station is only accessible while the Sun is in its subgiant phase, because it is destroyed when the Sun becomes a Red Giant.
The Sun Station was designed by the Nomai to induce a supernova in the Sun, but ultimately failed.
After the supernova, a glowing remnant resembling a white dwarf or neutron star is left behind.
The Sun's remnant is actually a rendering bug where the Sun's glow effect is not unloaded; red solar flares can still be seen on it.
All planets appear visually intact after the supernova in the game.
Mica's model spaceship can be flown from the Village into the Sun or Hollow's Lantern, granting the 'Mica's Wrath' achievement on Xbox, PlayStation, and Steam.
mechanics: The player can fly outside the supernova's blast radius but will still die with an alternative screen fade as their memories are uploaded to the Ash Twin Project.
Escaping the supernova after removing the Advanced Warp Core from Ash Twin triggers the Isolation Ending.
The Sun Station is normally accessed via a Nomai teleporter.
Manually landing on the Sun Station (without the teleporter) grants the 'Hotshot' achievement and requires accounting for the Sun's gravity and the station's rapid orbit.
